design: v002 to R06. About 1.9 m water-edge clump: twelve Typha shoots of broad strap leaves, many arching outward and down, green mixed with dry straw; three cattails (one bursting into fluff); two Phragmites culms with broad leaves and big pale silvery plumes; broken dead stems and dead leaves at the base of a wet mud tuft with pebbles and grass.
material_direction: Leaves green with pale bases yellowing to straw tips, many fully dry, dead ones grey-brown; dark cinnamon velvet cattails, white fluff; pale buff-silver plumes; dead stems grey-straw; near-black wet mud with puddles and a pale silt rim.
front_axis: -Y (Blender); GLB exported +Y up, so the front faces +Z in glTF space
not_reproduced_in_game_material: crystal transmission (crystals are opaque with baked colour and emission)
iron metallic (baked as dark iron-grey dielectric: base colour mixed toward 0.055 grey by the metallic amount)
